calls.title: 30 min with Karen (Jake Heier)
calls.summary: Jake Heier (sales) and Karen Henke (product marketing) discussed GrowthBook's competitive advantages over Statsig, focusing on pain points like pricing (cheaper at scale but per-seat cost for broad access), open-source flexibility, transparency (SQL queries for credibility), and lack of an AI story. They also covered security/self-hosting, rapid implementation, and white-glove support. Next steps: Karen will draft a stronger security page and revamp industry pages, while Jake suggested a blog on handling billions of events; he also offered to connect Karen with internal experts (Bryce, Jeremy, Graham) for implementation
